# AI agents vs workflow automation

> A decision guide for choosing between an AI agent, a deterministic workflow, or both. Short answer: use a workflow when the rule and steps are known and the output must be repeatable; use an agent when the task needs judgment, free text or varying tools; use both for most real jobs, with an approval step before hard-to-undo writes. Includes runnable Python for a decision scorecard, a deterministic workflow, an agent loop with guardrails and a hybrid pipeline.

Stacksync Workflow Automation: https://www.stacksync.com/workflow-automation
Stacksync AI agents (Genies): https://www.stacksync.com/ai-agents
Stacksync MCP: https://www.stacksync.com/mcp
